name: @demo/cookie-bff
description: Vite + React cookie-BFF auth demo for the orpc-ws-library e2e suite. The browser holds NOTHING; the httpOnly `sid` cookie set by the server authenticates the WS handshake automatically (no `?token=`). Imports ONLY @orpc-ws/client + @orpc-ws/react (no oidc packages, no tokenProvider) to prove the cookie WS-only consumer path. Runs standalone (dev: vite on 5175, e2e: vite preview on 4175).
